name: c2m_024
quarantine: wizard-config.yaml sets controller.mpc_implementation: kinematic_ideal, while every other run, including the reference r06, uses linear. Its physics.txt shows motion a real car cannot make: max_abs_accel 8.236 m/s², p99_abs_jerk 86.8, and a step to -8.01 m/s² at t=4.7 s. The label does not record a controller change, so its tracking and collision metrics measure a different setup from the rest of the batch.
